title: Fonts per layout
description: The layouts with their fonts: one row per layout that shows a matching font use, with the number and names of its named fonts, the matching uses, and the objects whose font is left to the default of the file. Filters for file, theme, font, size, source and object type, and the search, decide which layouts appear; the font columns always show the whole layout. By default only uses with a named font count. A click opens the objects of the layout; the arrow opens the layout with the matching objects marked.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: File filter: file names, comma-separated (the app-level file filter is one of them); empty = all files.

params.name: scope_uuids
params.description: Analysis-Test scope: comma-separated layout or layout-object UUIDs.

params.name: search
params.description: Search term, matched per font use (font, layout, object, field, theme, style, file, type, size, source): a layout appears when one of its uses matches.

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme filter: theme names separated by '|'; empty = all themes.

params.name: font
params.description: Font filter: normalised font keys (lower case) separated by '|'; empty = all fonts.

params.name: size
params.description: Size filter: sizes such as 12pt separated by '|'; empty = all sizes.

params.name: source
params.description: Source chip: empty = uses with a named font (all but the file default), 'all', or one of local, local_redundant, style, theme, rich_text, chart, default.

params.name: otype
params.description: Object-type chip: text, field, dropdown, popup, checkbox, radio, calendar, button, tab, chart; empty = all.

params.name: many
params.description: '1' = only layouts with more named fonts than font_max (tile 'Layouts with many fonts'); empty = all.

params.name: font_max
params.description: Threshold of 'many fonts': a layout with more named fonts than this (default 3). The file default is not a font.

params.name: layouts_sort
params.description: Sort column of the layout list (server sort).
